Dialogs.Dialog: Anegasaki
Hmm.
What's wrong？
Well, I think this every year, but New Year's resolutions are something you forget after a while, right？
So every year, I try to make one I won't forget.
But I have no idea what kind of resolution you'd never forget.
A resolution you'd never forget, huh.
Any idea？
Hmm... This is difficult.
Right？ So I'm often still worrying about it when spring comes.
Haah... what should I do this year？
Anegasaki
Hey, there's something I've always wondered about...
What？
In kindergarten, didn't you make ogre masks for Setsubun？
Ah, I did.
So here's the thing... you throw beans too, right？ "Ogres out～"
Yeah. It's Setsubun.
But the ones throwing beans aren't the ogres, right？ So why does everyone make ogre masks？
Huh？
See？ Not everyone becomes an ogre, yet everyone makes an ogre mask. Strange, right？
Yeah, now that you mention it.
Right？
Anegasaki
Hey... boys sometimes find elaborate presents too heavy, right？
Hmm... depends on the person？
How about you？
I'd just be happy, I think.
Really？
Yeah, why？
I see... thank goodness.
Is something up？
No, just talking to myself. It's nothing, don't worry about it.
Anegasaki
Hey, are you bad with sweets？
...Ah, it's already that time of year.
Oh my, what time of year would that be？
Who knows？
Ufu. Then, among sweets, is there anything sweet you especially like？
Hmm. Nothing in particular, I guess？
Lots of boys like bitter flavors. How about you？
Not that either... I guess？
Geez, you could at least give me a hint.
Anegasaki
It's almost Valentine's. Is there anything you want？
Hmm... just getting chocolate would make me happy？
Something else is fine too, you know？
Something else？
I mean, if it's food, it doesn't have to be chocolate... or something like clothes or shoes.
Hmm... but it's Valentine's, so chocolate after all？
Then, besides chocolate？
Chocolate is plenty.
Tell me if you think of something. Giving you presents makes me happy.
Anegasaki
It's almost time for the Hina dolls. Doesn't it feel like spring is finally coming？
Hina dolls... you mean the Doll Festival？
Is that weird？
I kind of get it, I guess.
At my house, we've always set up the dolls in a rush on the night of the 2nd.
Hehe. We take the boxes out a bit earlier, but the decorating gets put off.
So until the day before, the room is full of wooden boxes and kind of bleak...
But on the day, the dolls are up, and the whole house suddenly feels bright and festive.
Ah, so that's why it's spring.
Yes. So for me, winter doesn't end until I see the Hina dolls.
Come to think of it, White Day is coming up...
Anegasaki
It's fine, really. Just being with you is enough for me.
I can't just leave it like that.
No, really, it's fine. Besides... you know...
Hm？
Well... don't you have return gifts for girls other than me？
Eh？
Ah, no, never mind. Never mind.
Anyway, it's nothing much, but I'll give you a proper return gift.
O-okay. But I'm happier with you by my side than with a present... just remember that, okay？
Anegasaki
Hehe. It's almost... you know？
Almost... you mean White Day？
Geez, you're supposed to play dumb there, or it's no fun.
Sorry.
No apologizing either. If you're going to apologize, shouldn't you do all sorts of things on White Day？
I'm stuck. All sorts of things...
Hehe. Kidding, kidding.
Then on White Day...
I'll expect it, but not too much. But don't push yourself. No trying too hard, okay？
That was my plan from the start.
Hehe. I can't wait. To see what you'll give me.
Ah, come to think of it, White Day is coming up... what should I do？
Anegasaki
Geez, there's no point asking me that, is there？
When you put it that way...
Hehe. Paying back triple is common sense, right？ I'm expecting it, okay？
Triple... I wonder if my allowance will cover it.
No, it's not about money. What matters is how much feeling you put into it... that's the point.
So... triple the feelings？
Yes, that's right. And... in my case, I accept installments too, you know.
How generous.
Hehe. So the fee's easy. The due date, of course, is the 14th, okay？
Anegasaki
It's already cherry blossom season...
Pretty...
Did you know？ Apparently cherry trees wither quickly if people don't take care of them.
They're hard to grow, huh.
Don't you think that's just like the bonds between people？
That's why I like cherry trees. Spring cherry trees, summer cherry trees, autumn ones, winter ones.
Cherry trees outside of spring... I don't remember them.
That's normal. But cherry blossoms don't just suddenly appear in spring, you know？
The cherry tree is always there.
Always there... huh.
Hehe. I'm always here too. As long as you want me.
Anegasaki
It's almost Golden Week. Do you have plans？
Nothing. What about you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Me neither. At this rate, maybe it'll be work the whole time？
Then maybe I'll do that too.
Ah, you don't have to go out of your way to keep me company, you know？
I'll earn some money and be with ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, so it's killing two birds with one stone.
Geez... what are you going to do with all that money？
What about you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Me？ I'm... um... for date money and stuff...
L-like I said, girls have lots of expenses！ ...Geez.
Anegasaki
...Hah.
What's wrong？
You know perfectly well... look, the sports festival is coming up, right？
Were you bad at sports？
I'm confident in my stamina, you know？ But running and jumping... haah.
So even ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ gets gloomy sometimes.
Hmph.
It's fine. It'll work out somehow.
...If it doesn't work out, I'm taking it out on you.
...Ah, you switched to the summer uniform.
Anegasaki
Geez... you're only noticing now？
Sorry. I didn't notice.
Anything else to say？
It suits you. It suits you so well that it didn't seem out of place, maybe.
Hehe. Thank you. I'll forgive you on account of the flattery.
It wasn't flattery.
I wonder？
...You haven't forgiven me, have you？
I have, you know？ I'm just being a little mean.
Hehe, a little is okay, right？
Anegasaki
It's almost Tanabata... what do you think of the Tanabata legend？
Hikoboshi and Orihime？
Yes. It's a story about lovers reuniting, so it's romantic, I suppose, but...
After they reunite, they're separated again, right？ They can only meet on the night of July 7th. The next morning, they can't see each other anymore... don't you think that's really painful？
Normally... it'd be painful.
Yes, so. It's silly, but even on days I see you, when I get home I think, how many days until I see you next.
Sorry for saying something weird.
Good thing it's not just once a year, huh.
Yeah...
Summer break's almost here...
Anegasaki
Hehe, are you choosing not to think about the finals before that？
No point panicking now.
Is that confidence？ Or are you just giving up？
Hmm. Who knows？
Hehe. After the tests, let's talk lots about summer break, okay？
How about before the exams？
In moderation, we can talk about it？
So we can talk about it.
Well, you'll want to, right？ This summer only comes once.
Come to think of it, when does beach season open again？
Anegasaki
Ah, well...
...What's wrong？
Mm... you won't laugh if I tell you？
Yeah.
You see... just a little, but... I might have gained weight...
Really？ It doesn't look that way to me...？
Yes. Okay. I've decided！
Eh？
I'm going to work hard on my diet. So I can wear a swimsuit proudly！
...Just don't overdo it, okay？
All right, I'm going to give it my all.
(She's not listening...)
Anegasaki
Oh right. The fireworks festival is coming up soon.
Fireworks... nice.
Then... what about a yukata？
Yukata？
They say boys don't mind girls in yukata... what about you？
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ in a yukata... yeah, nice.
Then maybe I'll wear one for the fireworks.
...Then, me too？
No, you're fine as usual.
Um, how do I put it. I just... want you to look at me in a yukata...
I-Is that so...？
...Yeah.
Anegasaki
Summer break's almost over...
Yeah...
Hehe. When I'm with you, time seems to fly by.
They say fun times end quickly.
You feel that way too？
Of course.
I wonder if time will keep flying by like this from now on too...
If so, that just means we'll have that many more fun memories.
...Yeah, I think so.
Let's keep making lots of fun memories from now on too, okay？
Anegasaki
It's almost the moon viewing season.
Moon viewing, huh. We don't really do it at my house.
Hey. When did you find out there's no rabbit on the moon？
Hmm, I can't remember.
For me, it was when I was really little. There's no air or water on the moon, so no rabbits either.
Were you shocked？
No, I was relieved.
Relieved？
I felt sorry for it. Because the moon rabbit only eats rice cakes, right？ Even though rabbits are supposed to love carrots.
Ah, I see. You thought it could only eat something it didn't even like.
Yes. So I was relieved. Though maybe there were moon carrots, you never know.
Anegasaki
Don't you think our school's winter uniform is better than the summer one？
Hmm. I think neither's bad. Especially since both suit ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Geez... saying that. I bet you think the thin summer one's better, don't you.
...I can't say that's not true.
Hehe. Then should I stay in the summer uniform forever？
Then you'll catch a cold.
Then you'll nurse me, right？
Even if it's not then, if you catch a cold, I'll nurse you. Promise.
Ah, no, it's fine. I don't want you to catch it...
...Besides, people often say I get childish when I have a fever.
No, just visiting is plenty. Nursing me is... um... embarrassing... okay？
Come to think of it, the culture festival's coming up. What are you doing, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Anegasaki
I might help out somewhere, but I don't have any particular plans... I guess？ What about you？
Nothing in particular either.
Hehe. So you're free.
Probably.
Then, want to go around together？
Is that okay？ Just having fun without helping anywhere.
It's a festival. If no one goes around looking, it won't be lively, right？
True. Feels kind of sneaky, though.
It's fine. If I can have fun with you, being a little sneaky is okay.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, are you bad at winter sports too？
Anegasaki
Skating？ Or skiing？
If you can't, just say so. I don't want to invite you and make you have a bad time.
No. As long as I'm with you, I can have fun anywhere.
So, how about it？
Um... skiing, a little.
Really？
My grandma's place in the country is in snow country. So I did a little when I was small.
Huh. Then maybe a ski resort this winter.
Yes. And let's make a big snowman together.
(...What about skiing？)
It's almost Christmas...
Anegasaki
Hot Christmas...
Eh？
Ah, yes... it was on TV before. Christmas alone is cold, but Christmas with someone you love is warm.
That's why it's hot.
Yes. For me too, ever since I met you.
And for me too, of course.
I'll keep you warm. So you keep me warm too, okay？
It's almost Christmas...
Anegasaki
Of course, it's a hotel suite, right？
Eh？
Oh, I know. How about a night cruise by helicopter？
Um...
Hehe, I was obviously joking, right？
Joking？
My ideal is spending it quietly, just the two of us, anywhere.
No presents needed. Just having you with me is enough.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲... don't scare me like that.
Hehe, sorry. I just couldn't help teasing you.
It's almost Christmas...
Anegasaki
Hehe. Don't you think this season is really cruel to people who are alone？
Hmm, I wonder？
Well, in Japan, it's a romantic event on par with Valentine's, right？
Well, yeah.
So I always thought it was a cruel season.
Do you still think so？
No. Because I have you.
Yeah. With ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, it's warm for me too.
Hehe. This Christmas, big sis will warm you up even more▼
Anegasaki
This year's already ending...
Yeah, so fast...
What was the biggest thing this year？ For you.
Eh？ Me？
Starting to date？
Our first kiss？
What was it？
Starting to date, I guess.
...Truthfully, I never thought you'd say yes.
I just wanted to end my murky one-sided love... that's all I was thinking.
End it？
Yes. That's why I was surprised. I meant to end it, and it turned into a beginning.
I see.
...Let's get along next year too.
Same here.
Starting to date, sure, but for me... you know, our first kiss.
Ah, yes... same for me. And it was a little strange...
Strange？
Just from that... just our lips touching... I felt like I understood you so well... like I'd known you forever...
Me too！ What was that？
I don't really know... but it makes me so happy. That I felt that.
Yes... so that moment must be special.
Special, just for us...
...Yeah.
Um, what was it？
Aww... I mean, you know, that.
That？
You really, truly don't know？
No. Sorry.
Geez... You idiot.
Anegasaki
This year's already ending...
A lot happened this year too.
Yes. I hope we can still be like this this time next year...
Can we？
We can. I bet we'll be saying "a lot happened" to each other again.
Will a lot happen, I wonder.
It will, I'm sure.
Yes, you're right.
Let's do lots together next year too. Promise？
It's gradually getting warmer.
Anegasaki
Hehehe. Spring's almost here, so of course.
Of course, huh.
Just because it's spring, don't become a habitual oversleeper, okay？
I'm fine, I'm fine.
Apparently some people are the exception in spring, you know？
I'm fine, really.
Hehe. It's a good season for naps too, so maybe a lap pillow？
I'd like to ask for that even if I'm not sleepy.
Hehe, someday.
(Someday... hmm.)
Anegasaki
*Yawn*...
Are you sleepy？
Yes, a little... maybe because it's spring？
Want to rest a bit？
No, I'm not that sleepy. How do I put it... it's all warm and toasty, it feels nice？
It's spring, after all.
Hehe. And maybe because you're next to me？
Me？
Hmm... for me, you're like a cat's sunny spot？
Meaning a place where you can relax？
Yes. ...I hope I'm that for you too.
Anegasaki
It's slowly getting hotter, huh.
Summer's almost here.
Yes. Ah, want to take off your jacket？ It's a bit hot today too...
I'm fine. More importantly, what about you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？ Not hot？
I'm fine for now. It's just under the sun...
Ah, it's not that I'm hot. I didn't do anything for UV protection, so I'm a little worried.
Is your skin sensitive？
Not sensitive, but not that tough either. Big sis is getting old, you know.
With skin that youthful？
Geez... it was a joke, just brush it off.
It's especially hot today...
Anegasaki
Yeah. But there's that saying... "clear your mind" something, and even fire feels cool？
The mind... what was it？
What was it？
Hmm... I think the word started with "me"？
Me... me... melanin？
As in pigment？
Aww, not that, me... me... men？ Men-something？
Men... like noodles？
Come to think of it, they say eating hot ramen makes you feel cooler. Do you think that's true？
Who knows？
Who knows.
Our brains aren't really working, huh.
Anegasaki
Lately, doesn't it suddenly get chilly in the mornings and evenings？
Fall's arrived, I guess？
But it doesn't feel like fall yet, does it？
The real thing is still to come, isn't it？
Hehe. Speaking of fall, what do you associate with it？
Hmm... autumn leaves, I guess？
Not that... there are lots, right？ Fall for reading, fall for sports.
What about you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Romance, of course. It's getting cold, so linking arms is only natural, right？
(You can link arms even when it's hot, though...)
Anegasaki
Hey, is there anything you want to eat？
Something I want to eat？ I'm not especially hungry right now, though.
Geez, not like that. You know, fall is the season when lots of tasty things are in season, right？
Ah, fall for appetites.
Yeah. So, is there anything？
Hmm... I feel like anything tastes good if I'm eating it with ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Geez... that makes me happy, but then I don't know what to do.
What do you mean？
Go somewhere to eat something good, or... try cooking something.
Oh, can I look forward to it？
Hehe, should I～▼
(Ugh, she's having fun teasing me...)
Ugh... winter must be coming soon.
Anegasaki
Are you cold？
I'm fine. More importantly, what about you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
I'm strong against the cold. More importantly, are you really fine？
Huh, you're strong against the cold.
Ah, yes. And of the four seasons, I like it best. It feels calm.
Including the year-end and New Year？
I'm not good with hustle and bustle. They don't call December "the month when even teachers run" for nothing.
This year, I'd like to take it easy with you.
Ugh, it's cold today.
Anegasaki
Bad with the cold？ I have a disposable hand warmer, want it？
Thanks. But I'm fine for now.
Geez, you need to dress warmer.
Right, I'll be careful.
Don't you dare catch a cold.
Yeah, I'm fine.
...Here, use the hand warmer after all.
But ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ will...
I'm fine, I'm really not cold. Listen to big sis for once.
Okay, thank you.
Geez... you could lean on me a little on your own, you know.
